title: IVG Pro 12 Banana Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Banana Ice IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods blend creamy, mellow Banana with a frosty Menthol undertone for a smooth yet refreshing vape. The sweetness of ripe Banana comes through on every puff, while the cooling edge adds clarity and a light, crisp finish. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically keeps the pod supplied as you vape, removing the need for refilling or coil changes. Each set provides up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on your usage. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour and vapour, while the secure click-fit design makes setup quick and mess-free. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
